units.source_text: 千重子在想：苗子和秀男站在那里究竟谈了些什么呢？

en.t: Chieko wondered: what on earth had Naeko and Hideo talked about while they stood there?

units.source_text: 秀男显然误将苗子当作自己，可是苗子又是怎样同秀男对答的呢？

en.t: Hideo had clearly mistaken Naeko for her, but how had Naeko answered him?

units.source_text: 她一定会感到很为难吧？

en.t: She must have felt terribly awkward.
